contents.text: You probably know about water floods, but did you ever think there could be a syrup flood? Strangely enough, there was one. It happened in Boston in 1919. One day, the tank burst, and the syrup shot out in a giant wave that flooded the streets. For decades after that, people claimed that downtown Boston smelled like molasses!
